title: Incident
description: A key moment of the match (a goal, a card, a penalty), with the score after it. Derived by the engine from the event feed.

id.description: Stable id: the same incident gets the same id when the match is replayed.

offset.description: Offset of the event the incident comes from.

play_s.description: Seconds of play when it happened, continuous across periods.

kind.title: IncidentKind
kind.description: What happened. penalty_goal and penalty_missed are penalties in play; shootout_goal and shootout_miss are kicks in the shootout, which do not count as goals.

team_id.description: The team it is for: the side that scored (for own_goal, the side the goal counts for), took the penalty, was awarded it, had the goal disallowed or was shown the card.

player.description: The player who scored, took the penalty, gave it away (if the provider says) or was shown the card. For own_goal, the opponent who put the ball into his own net.

score.description: The score after it, in the order of the teams.

cancels.description: On goal_disallowed: the id of the goal's incident.

reason.description: On goal_disallowed: why it was disallowed.
